newsitem.title: USA: Dean Witter earnings rose 9 percent.
newsitem.headline: Dean Witter earnings rose 9 percent.

text.p: Dean Witter, Discover & Co. said Wednesday that third-quarter earnings rose 9 percent, boosted by gains in its securities and credit services operations.

The New York-based brokerage said net income rose to $239 million in the quarter from $218.7 million in the 1995 quarter. Earnings per share rose to $1.41 from $1.23 in the third quarter of last year.
Analysts had forecast earnings of $1.36 a share, according to First Call, which tracks estimates.
Revenues rose 5 percent to $1.53 billion from $1.45 billion.

"We are very pleased with these results," Chairman Philip Purcell said in a statement. "Earnings were up strongly in securities. We continued to grow our assets under management and our expense discipline has been superb."
Operating earnings in securities grew 12 percent while profits rose 7 percent in credit services.
Dean Witter stock rose 62.5 cents to $59.25 in afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
